members.onlyOwnerNote: As the only owner, you cannot leave until another owner is added.

invites.regenerateConfirm: Generate a new invite code? The current code stops working immediately — anyone you already shared it with will need the new one. Existing members are unaffected.

devices.emptyBody: Run devpulse login on your machine — your browser will open to authorize this computer.

cli.openclawPrompt:
Set up DevPulse CLI on this machine (Node.js 22+):

npm install -g devpulse-ai
devpulse login
devpulse sync

Run in order. devpulse login opens a browser to authorize — complete it (ask me if needed). Then run devpulse status and report the result.
cli.step1Body: Requires Node.js 22+. Run once per machine.
cli.step2Body: Opens your browser to authorize the CLI — similar to Claude Code device login.
cli.step3Body: Scans local AI tool logs and uploads usage metadata — tokens, activity, summaries, and more. Run again anytime.
cli.compactNote: Check configuration anytime with devpulse status. Only usage metadata is uploaded — never code or transcripts.
cli.connectTitle: Connect your machine to see data here
cli.connectBody: The dashboard fills in after you install the CLI and run devpulse sync on your laptop. Only lightweight usage metadata is uploaded — never code or transcripts.
cli.openclawTitle: Copy this prompt and let OpenClaw handle setup
cli.openclawBody: Works with OpenClaw, which can complete the browser login for you. Sandboxed agents (e.g. cloud-based ones) can't — use the manual steps instead.
cli.afterSync: After syncing, refresh the dashboard to see your data.
